terra.problem: He says the leaf blower is on 'my street,' inventing a street outside his bakery rather than describing something people experience.
He states that the young man has confidence without marking it as his own impression.
The passage says the man came up to Jesus, not that he came running.
He comments on his own storytelling by saying he is not going to joke about the moment.
The burnt-tray comparison does not match the point about what is impossible with man and possible with God.
